comments.author: @Matix8998
comments.text:
Your video presents a narrative suggesting that, prior to the construction of this canal, Russia had full control over Poland’s maritime trade. In reality, Poland’s major ports—such as those in Gdańsk, Gdynia, and Świnoujście are located directly on the Baltic Sea and are not blocked by any country.

To be precise, this canal has provided Poland with independent access to the ports in Elbląg, which represent a completely marginal share of Poland’s overall maritime trade.
